help.a1: For the software and technical capabilities to arrange a deal: participant verification, recording terms, documents, history and support. The client pays for freight directly to the carrier.

help.a9: The driver can mark checkpoints offline — they are saved on the phone and sent automatically.

landing.lead: AbdEX connects shippers and carriers in one environment: orders, bids, deal terms, documents and correspondence are recorded with a verifiable history.
landing.step1: The client publishes an order: route, cargo, dates and vehicle requirements.
landing.step2: Verified carriers submit bids; the client compares them and negotiates.
landing.step3: Acceptance locks in the terms, and the parties sign the order contract on the platform.
landing.step4: The driver marks checkpoints, documents are uploaded to the deal, and the deal is closed.
landing.title: Freight platform with verified participants
legal.privacy_1: Full name, phone, e-mail, IIN, driver document details, vehicle information, location during the trip — only to the extent necessary for the stated purpose.
legal.privacy_2: Registration, participant verification, deal execution, platform security. Consents are collected separately for each purpose and can be withdrawn in your profile.
legal.privacy_3: Servers and backups containing personal data of users from Kazakhstan are located in the Republic of Kazakhstan.
legal.privacy_4: Retention periods are set per data category; once they expire, data is deleted or anonymized automatically.
legal.privacy_5: Request information about processing, correct or delete your data, withdraw consent — via your profile or support.
legal.security_1: Passwords are stored only as argon2id hashes. Two-factor authentication is mandatory for company owners and platform staff.
legal.security_2: All significant actions are recorded in an audit log that cannot be modified or deleted.
legal.security_3: If you have found a vulnerability, write to security@abdex.kz. We will respond within 3 business days.
legal.terms_1: AbdEX is the operator of an online platform and is not a party to the contract of carriage, a carrier or a freight forwarder.
legal.terms_2: Deal terms are recorded in an immutable snapshot on acceptance. Changes are possible only with the other party's consent.
legal.terms_3: Documents are signed with a simple electronic signature (SMS code), recording the time, user, IP and document hash. Signing with an NCA RK e-signature has a separate status.
legal.terms_4: The platform fee is charged for each deal concluded through AbdEX at the rate in effect on the deal date.
